source: C++ reference: decodeBGRA of the system grabber with the default LUT loaded by LutLoader (tests/golden/HdrGolden.cpp)
description: BGRA input: the RGB test image as B, G, R, A with A = (x * 31 + y * 17) & 255 and row padding bytes 0xEE; output: RGB24 of targetWidth x targetHeight, pixel (i, j) taken from source (startX + i * division, min(startY + j * division, height - 1)).
